**Summary of visual analysis:**

**Test image:** Two bell peppers with very large, dark/black sunken lesions covering most of the fruit surface, with wrinkled/collapsed texture and concentric ring patterns. Classic fruit rot presentation.

**Key evidence:**
- Bugwood ID on test image: 1568070; the Phytophthora_Blight Bugwood_100 reference is ID 1568066 — consecutive images from the same collection/photographer, strongly indicating the same disease context (Phytophthora on pepper)
- Phytophthora_Blight Bugwood_153 shows a tomato fruit with large, dark brown/concentric ring lesion pattern — structurally similar to the test image
- Anthracnose references showed small circular lesions or whitish/tan lesions — do not match the large dark lesions in the test image
- Alternaria and Rhizopus references were microscopic or showed stem/root disease

The large, dark, sunken, wrinkled lesions covering most of the pepper fruit surface, combined with the Bugwood ID proximity to the Phytophthora pepper collection, point clearly to **Phytophthora_Blight**.
